scope: TPR decomposition with fixed coordinatewise monotonic bounding; no query-answer feature, KL loss, history gates or generic neural map
selection: Focused replay/refit of the two published models; no fresh model selection. Historical selection is documented separately.
notes: All activation functions have slope one at zero. Centered sigmoid is exactly tanh after rescaling, so is not a separate candidate.
Inventory and geometry are marginal tensor terms; centering alone is an exact reparameterization at initialization, while independent marginal heads relax shared-rank constraints.
No future/query label, node ID, or visitation-dependent gate is a model input. The original observed-current-input and integrated-position context q is retained in every model.
Latent factor transposition exchanges filler/role naming without increasing capacity; it is tested as an algebraic identity, not an independent candidate.
